content: Melvin-Koushki explains in a footnote that the principle of tajdīd holds that a renewer (mujaddid) arises at the head of every century, and that Shāhrukh himself was first declared the mujaddid of the ninth Islamic century by Jalāl al-Dīn Qāyinī in the Naṣāʾiḥ-i Shāhrukhī, a claim repeated by Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī and ʿAbd al-Razzāq Samarqandī.
